summary: NewAmsterdam Pharma Co N.V. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on July 24, 2026, announcing that it and partner Menarini Group received a positive CHMP opinion from the EMA recommending marketing authorization for Ubeslo (obicetrapib monotherapy) and Evlarco (obicetrapib plus ezetimibe FDC) for primary hypercholesterolemia. No deal terms (price, premium, etc.) were disclosed; the filing is a routine regulatory milestone press release. The European Commission decision is expected in 2H26. This is an operational/regulatory update, not a special situation. What to watch: final EC approval and commercial launch timing.
